summary: Sidecars compose with the repository's documentation, memory, locality and generated-view patterns.

items.text: Companion metadata is the structured data layer beneath the cognitive wiki.
Keep decisions and their rationale searchable beside the artifacts they govern.
Place companions with the feature rather than in a central metadata layer.
Treat cached generated interfaces as fingerprinted, disposable sidecars whose source artifacts remain authoritative.
Use task, lifecycle, pipeline and result sidecars as a repository-local projection of the run trace; stable task and run identities keep the files correlated.

See Companion App for the related use case or counterpoint: Give every fast-changing system a separate, navigable product surface through which people can catch up with, understand and care for what has been built.

See Continuous Two-Way Alignment for the related use case or counterpoint: Continuously reconcile system artifacts and their human-facing companion in both directions so neither machine progress nor human knowledge becomes an isolated, drifting truth.
See Versioned Prompt Text for the related use case or counterpoint: Keep prompts as plain files in the code repository, and link every model call to the exact prompt version that produced it.
